text: Home - NCCTDXB Welcome to NCCTDXB NCCT is a patented and innovative lighting system using LED technology. It is a product combining enormous possibilities of creating the space with light while maintaining low operating cost. Design Your Lighting The solutions we use in NCCT lighting enable us the creation of almost any lighting project – the technology used allows the production of extremely plastic, durable and retaining shape-memory forms that can be freely combined into completely personalized lighting systems unprecedented anywhere else before. The light creates a form What makes NCCT unique is the implementation of your visions – lighting that is not only functional, but also creates space and emphasizes the architectural values ​​of the given place. Find out more about our possibilities through the record of our previous projects. DISCOVER OUR NCCT LIGHTS The Exhibition Congress Centre rooftop could feature UAE-inspired lighting and the phrase "Bridging Nations." A inspired light line could cross building floors, symbolizing connection and innovation. could have-inspired NCCT lighting Universal solutions The specification of the NCCT product makes it applicable in almost every industry – it can be successfully used as functional hotel lighting, for creating an advertising neon sign or become a unique element of the scenery, both inside the building and on its facade. Discover the possibilities offered by NCCT for various industries. Discover the our lighting in diverse industries: Indoor Lights See our solutions for Industrial Lights. Outdoor Lights See NCCT possibilities for advertisement and signage branch. Decorative Ligts Find out more on the solutions made for retail industry. Industrial Lights Check how our lighting is applied for the needs of TV, Stage and Entertainment scenography. We recognize that we have a legitimate interest in the processing of your data to ensure the proper performance of contracts with our contractors, including where necessary to establish, assert or defend legal claims arising from or related to the contract. The recipients of your data can be entities cooperating with Lumotubo Sp z o.o. for the purpose to perform the contract . Personal data, in cases required by law, may be transferred to supervisory authorities, courts and other authorities (e.g. tax and law enforcement authorities), independent external advisors (e.g. auditors, legal advisers). Personal data will be processed for the period necessary to achieve the purposes indicated above, during the contract and in accordance with the limitation period for claims related to it. You have the right to access your data and – if circumstances provided for by law – the right to rectify, delete, limit processing, the right to object, withdraw consent, if it has been expressed. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory body if you believe that the processing of your personal data violates the provisions of the GDPR or other provisions. From May 25, 2018, the President of the Office for Personal Data Protection is the supervisory authority in Poland. Providing your data is voluntary, however, the consequence of not providing this data will be the inability to perform the contract with you or your employer or principal.

text: Case Study - Lumo Tubo Case Study Detailed information about our inspiring and original lighting projects – find out even better about the possibilities offered by LumoTubo lighting system. Implementation of digital LED lighting in the TV studio of The Voice of Poland A complex and multi-department realization of LED lighting for the TV studio of The Voice broadcasted on the Polish TVP2. Realization of 3D light structure in the lobby of Skyliner building in Warsaw. Skyliner is a newly built Scyscraper in Warsaw, the architect’s idea was a complicated 3D structure over the reception desk in building’s lobby. Complex realization of LED lighting for Delta Planet’s Shopping Centre alleys in Niš, Serbia. LumoTubo realized a considerable project of  approx. 1700 m of long LED tubes segments (5,5m) illuminating on the whole surface 360°. No other company was able to fulfill these custom requirements. Manufacturing of the prototype of the unique, complicated luminaire in the hall of Warsaw’s building. LumoTubo according to an individual, original architectural design has manufactured futuristic LED luminaires- a combination of CNC cut perforated sheets of metal and modern lighting tube. Project realized at Aurum building at Grzybowski Square in Warsaw and until today it delights all the visitors. Rzeszow Exhibition & Congress Centre rooftop light outline realization. LumoTubo has manufactured, supplied and mounted (by alpinistic climbers) LED lighting on the rooftop of Exhibition & Congress Centre in Jasionka near Rzeszow Installation of light neon Lumotubo logo on the facade of the headquarter’s building. LumoTubo logo has been mounted on the glass facade of its headquarter in Lublin, Poland. The sign is equipped in digital, pixel- controlled LED strips programmed via DMX.

text: Pomoc #2 - Lumo Tubo Problem? We will help! We will try to help you with your problem – see the questions below, and if you do not find a satisfactory answer there, write us using the contact form. How to order a lamp? Contact us by phone, e-mail or directly via contact form on the website of the lamp or system that interest you – we will contact you and quote the products you are interested in. Can I replace the product? Każda nasza lampa podlega zwrotowi przez 14 dni od daty dostarczenia. When will my order arrive? As soon as possible – it all depends on the number of lamps in the order and possible personalization options. Ask about the transport time when placing the order. I would like to order many lamps. What do I do? Describe how many and what lamps or systems you would like to order. We will contact you and discuss the details. Can I personalize the lamp? Yes, each lamp has specific personalization options – contact us and ask for details. Where can I see the lamps? You can see our lamps on our website, social-media channels, reports from fairs and industry events and on our YouTube channel. Questions? Contact us! info@lumotubo.eu +48 81 461 00 41

text: Huda successful cooperation - Lumo Tubo news / THE IMPRESSIVE START OF LUMOTUBO AND HUDA LIGHTING COOPERATION IN DUBAI! THE IMPRESSIVE START OF LUMOTUBO AND HUDA LIGHTING COOPERATION IN DUBAI! Saturday, 18.12.2021 r. < HUDA Lighting – a key business partner of LumoTubo in the Middle East, is the author of the project to install the LED segment system in The Space – a newly commissioned building in the exclusive district of Dubai – Marina combining the features of a luxury car showroom, fitness and sports zone, restaurant and leisure space . The rounded LED line of light flowing along various spaces of the building is a great showcase of The Space.
